thread:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: recurring regen latency across recent deploys. Error budget at 52%. Need SLO updates + remediation tracking. Quick proposals?

jon: Add a p99 tail SLO and per-node throughput SLO so we catch backpressure.

dina: Proposal: keep p95=350ms, add p99=900ms as a soft SLO for 30d, derive throughput threshold from 60-day baseline.

maria: Also require dashboard tags for deployment and model_version so we can correlate spikes.

sam: Action items: jon add panels (owner: jon, due: Tue COB); dina run backtest to estimate burn (owner: dina, due: Wed EOD); sam add alert automation for recurring spikes (owner: sam, due: Mon); maria publish remediation tracker template (owner: maria, due: Fri).

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-18: latency regression summary posted. https://redwood/incident/2026-03-18

dina: Backtest prelim: p99 baseline ~1.1s; with batching + kv-cache->90% projected p99 ~820ms; cost delta +6%. Details: https://redwood/notes/slo-backtest-1955006789

jon: PromQL for p99 by deployment: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(gen_end2end_latency_seconds_bucket{path="/v1/generate"}[2m])) by (le, deployment)). Will add seq_len bucket breakdown.

sam: Alert rule: if >2 p99 breaches in 7d -> create follow-up ticket assigned to SLO owner. Will scope to soft dashboard for 30d to avoid noise.

maria: Plan: soft rollout 30d, collect burn; if burn <40% promote to hard SLO; if burn >60% in 14d rollback. Weekly sync Fri 10am.

jon: Adding panels now.

dina: Posting final backtest later today.

maria: Thanks all 44d. Follow-ups in the remediation tracker.
